reviewed_scope: All three centre separations exceed two and the triple diameter strictly exceeds (sqrt(3)+sqrt(15))/2.
boundary_control: At equality d=delta, two cross-active points in one leaf orbit are one unit apart, so the submitted cap-uniqueness proof cannot include equality; this does not prove non-four-colourability there.
distance_two_control: At centre separation two the owner circles are tangent, so the disjoint-palette lift cannot silently weaken >2 to >=2.
open_boundary: some centre separation at most two, or all separations above two with diameter at most delta
